As notified in the APPSC Advertisement No.02l2026 dated 23'd March 2026 and in
subsequent Notification of even no. dated 25th June 2026 for issue of Admit Card for Written
Examination (Objective), as well in the Result Notification dated 17ft July 2026 fot Written
Examination (Objective) of TGTE-2026(Secondary Level), the eligibility of candidates for appearing
in the InterviedViva-Voce shall be subject to the fulfilment of all the requisite eligibility conditions
for the post of Trained Graduate Teacher (Secondary Level).
Further, the Commission vide its Notification of even no. dated 3l't March 2026had informed
that as clarified by the Education Department vide their letter no.DSE-l101 11312025'DSE|322 of
dated 28.04.2025, the class/division mentioned in the Bachelor's Degree Certificate/Provisional
Certificate/N4arksheet, as specified by the respective university, shall be made the basis for
determining whether or not the candidate has secured the minimum required criteria of Second
Class/Second Division in Graduation.
Relaxation in the minimum eligibility criteria as specified in the Recruitment Rules and the
Advertisement, if any, is beyond the purview of the Commission. Therefore, all representations
seeking for relaxation of the Minimum Eligibility Criteria for TGTE-2026 (Secondary Level) will not
be considered by the Commission.
This is issued with the approval of the Competent Authority.
